does: Beats a liquid with a whisk until it is blended and smooth.
how: Use a bowl large enough that nothing slops over.
Tilt the bowl and beat in quick strokes that cross the middle.
Keep going until the mixture is one colour and one texture.

cues.text: No streaks. Beaten eggs are an even yellow that runs off the whisk in a thin stream.

mistakes.mistake: Whisking eggs for an omelette until they foam, which makes it spongy.
mistakes.fix: Stop as soon as the streaks of white are gone.
